name: Pairwise Non-Integer Harmonic Obfuscation
description: Replaces the 3D polarization vectors and global dot-product sum with a local harmonic resonance ratio $c_u/c_v + c_v/c_u$. A protocol is stable if this sum is strictly non-integer. This completely eliminates the geometric and energy-minimization vocabulary, forcing the model to algebraically evaluate the 9 possible pairs to discover the $c_u \neq c_v$ constraint, which defeats models that rely on pattern-matching the dot-product global sum formulation.
